player_text: I leave the coin where it is and follow his glance around the square. "Then point. Who here has those deeper roots, and will they talk to a stranger with a thin purse?"
visible_motivation: The runner says the scores are too tangled for him to name, and that I need someone with deeper roots than his.
intended_meaning: I want him to point me at a person in this square who will actually name names.
generation_attempt_1: "You'll want to keep your ears open for the families tied longest to this place, though few speak freely," the ragged stranger says quietly, nodding toward the cluster near the gate guard posts. "Noble houses like Verevin and shadowed groups like the Ash Cowl — both play dangerous games here. But talk? They won’t warm up to just any stranger, especially one with a thin purse." They glance sideways, voice dropping. "Silence often costs less than a coin, though it’s a rare favor to earn."
accepted_response_text: Ragged stranger grimaces. "Not something I can say here."
